info.name: VELO Full Backend - Delivery and Cash Cycle
info.description: Local Development only. Set ONLY operationsAccessToken, obtained with --issue-development-operations-token <actual verified user GUID>. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:5080. Choose No environment and run all 57 requests in order in Collection Runner within 10 minutes. The collection creates its own demo catalog, warehouse/20 units, customer, driver and two orders. It records delivery, cash handover, inbox read and a failed delivery/return without restock. The incorrect code and post-delivery code requests intentionally expect 400 and 409. Final stock is 17 units, reserved 0, outstanding driver cash 0. It uses simulated OTP and stops before demo registration unless the API reports Development/simulated codes. It does not clear any existing customer's cart. These are real local demo records; they are retained for inspection. Never export populated tokens or codes. See docs/fulfillment-api.md.
